result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the 'Popular right now' list item for Tokumaru Ramen Bar has a broken metadata line where the delivery time and delivery fee text overlap and become unreadable, and its rating label is tight against the right screen edge.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the Tokumaru Ramen Bar metadata line has overlapping text: the delivery time ('25–30 min') and price ('€0 delivery') are drawn on top of each other, producing garbled, unreadable text.
issues.suggestion: Fix the metadata row layout so the delivery time and price are placed side by side with adequate spacing, or wrap them onto separate lines.

issues.description: The rating row for Tokumaru Ramen Bar ('4.8 (500+)') is pushed to the far right edge of the screen and appears partially clipped by the viewport edge.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding so the rating and review count remain fully within the screen bounds.
